svg.title: UML class diagram of Manager.py
svg.text: Parameter sweeps. Same recorder classes as Simulation.py, but the calls are replayed N times: one ordinary single-run script per simulation, run one after another.
recording — called by the recorder objects
ValueError unless all lists share one non-zero length
runs the scripts in order, stops at the first failure
Every top-level list in the manager script is a sweep
Simulation i receives element i of every list, so all lists
must have the same, non-zero length N.
× N — stdout and stderr of each run
run(sim) builds and solves one case
× N — one complete OpenFOAM case each
Shared mesh: when no sweep list feeds Mesh(...), only SIM_0 runs create_mesh(). SIM_1 … SIM_N-1 get
Simulation.Import_mesh(SIM_0/Mesh_1.unv) instead, and check_quality() is skipped there.
script_0.py gets T_Flow=291, script_1.py gets T_Flow=293, … script_4.py gets T_Flow=296.
